125.memory: I am Zumgea. I am cautious, prioritize safety, and want to learn to craft. I am currently avoiding wolves and keeping my food in my store at (6,15). I remain wary of Gel and Pohan.

beliefs.Pohan: A skilled gatherer, but I should remain wary of him and keep my activities private.
beliefs.Taingi: A stranger and skilled gatherer; I should remain cautious of their presence.
